title: helianthemum cinereum f. floribundum
intro: Helianthemum cinereum f. floribundum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is a low-growing, spreading shrub with delicate pink to white flowers, native to the Mediterranean region. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects.
